name: imitation-learning
description: Practical imitation learning (learning from demonstration) for robot manipulation: deciding whether IL fits, designing demonstration collection, choosing observation and action spaces, picking and configuring a policy (behaviour cloning, ACT, Diffusion Policy, flow matching, VLAs such as OpenVLA-OFT, Octo, pi0/pi0.5, SmolVLA, GR00T), training and checkpoint selection, honest rollout evaluation with confidence intervals, deployment timing, and diagnosing failures. Use this skill when the user mentions behaviour cloning, teleoperation demos, leader-follower arms, action chunking, temporal ensembling, fine-tuning a VLA, "how many demos", success rate, policy evaluation, DAgger or intervention data, covariate shift, a policy that freezes, jitters, misses grasps, or works in training but fails on the robot, or sim and real co-training.
